detail.longDescription: Does somebody know, if the flat-file CMS "Datenstrom Yellow" (developed in Sweden) is still being actively maintained? The main developer hasn't answered to my mail from last weekend yet and I'm not sure, what's going on. The somehow spartanic CMS itself makes a pretty good impression to me: https://datenstrom.se/yellow/ # Followerpower # WebDev # Datenstrom # DatenstromYellow # YellowCMS # FlatFileCMS
